What are the core operations and their costs?

blocks.code:
Insert into HashMap/HashSet -> O(1)
Lookup into HashMap/HashSet -> O(1)
Delete from HashMap/HashSet -> O(1)
Iterating the array -> O(1)

Create an empty HashMap or HashSet
For each element in the array:
      Check if this element(or something related to it) exists
      in the map
      If YES -> you have your answer, return it
      If NO -> store this element and continue
Return result after the loop ends
